rules.title: San Francisco ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices using nonpublic competitor data
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use algorithmic devices that process nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy. Tenants can sue for damages, injunctive relief and civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, and each unit-month of use may count separately.
rules.requirement_es: Los arrendadores no pueden usar dispositivos algorítmicos que procesen información no pública de competidores para recomendar rentas u ocupación. Los inquilinos pueden demandar por daños, medidas cautelares y sanciones civiles de hasta $1,000 por infracción, y cada mes de uso por unidad puede contar como una infracción separada.
rules.quoted_span: The ordinance prohibits landlords from using qualifying algorithmic devices that calculate nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy.
rules.penalty: Civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation; each month of use for each affected dwelling unit may be a separate violation.
rules.caveat: Secondary source (law firm summary); effective date given only to the month. Currently being applied in Gomez v. Greystar (N.D. Cal.).

rules.title: San Diego ban on algorithmic rent-setting (RealPage-type) tools
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use algorithmic rent-pricing tools like RealPage. Tenants can sue for damages, injunctive relief and penalties up to $1,000 per violation, with each month and affected property possibly a separate violation.
rules.requirement_es: Los arrendadores no pueden usar herramientas algorítmicas de fijación de rentas como RealPage. Los inquilinos pueden demandar por daños, medidas cautelares y sanciones de hasta $1,000 por infracción, y cada mes y propiedad afectada puede ser una infracción separada.
rules.quoted_span: San Diego similarly authorizes tenant suits for damages, injunctive relief and penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, with each month and affected rental property potentially constituting a separate violation.
rules.penalty: Penalties of up to $1,000 per violation; each month and affected rental property may be a separate violation.
rules.caveat: Secondary source; effective date given only to the month. Being applied in Keller v. UDR (S.D. Cal.).

rules.title: Berkeley ban on coordinated pricing algorithms
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use coordinated rent-pricing algorithms. Violations can recur by unit and month and tenants have private remedies.
rules.requirement_es: Los arrendadores no pueden usar algoritmos coordinados de fijación de precios de renta. Las infracciones pueden repetirse por unidad y por mes, y los inquilinos tienen recursos privados.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits coordinated pricing algorithms; recurring unit/month violations and private remedies
rules.caveat: Secondary source; effective date to month only. The RealPage v. City of Berkeley challenge was voluntarily dismissed with prejudice on Jan. 14, 2026.

rules.title: Santa Ana Ordinance NS-3090 ban on automated rent price-fixing
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use automated systems to fix rents anticompetitively. Tenants can bring private claims for up to $1,000 per violation and per month.
rules.requirement_es: Los arrendadores no pueden usar sistemas automatizados para fijar rentas de manera anticompetitiva. Los inquilinos pueden presentar demandas privadas por hasta $1,000 por infracción y por mes.
rules.quoted_span: Ordinance NS-3090 prohibits specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing; private tenant claims and up to $1,000 per violation and per month.
rules.effective_date_quote: Santa Ana Ordinance No. NS-3090 (effective April 2, 2026)
rules.penalty: Up to $1,000 per violation and per month.
rules.caveat: Secondary source summary; ordinance code section not given.

rules.title: Jersey City ban on algorithmic rent coordination services
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use algorithmic rent coordination services. The ban is enforced publicly and by private action, with fines up to $2,000 per day.
rules.requirement_es: Los arrendadores no pueden usar servicios algorítmicos de coordinación de rentas. La prohibición se aplica por vía pública y privada, con multas de hasta $2,000 por día.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits a landlord’s use of algorithmic rent coordination services; includes public and private enforcement; fines up to $2,000 per day.
rules.caveat: Secondary source (law firm table); effective date to month only.

rules.title: Hoboken ban on software/algorithms coordinating rents
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms or occupancy.
rules.requirement_es: Los arrendadores no pueden usar software, algoritmos ni plataformas de intercambio de datos para coordinar o recomendar rentas, términos de arrendamiento u ocupación.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits landlords from using software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
rules.caveat: Secondary source; citation given as 'ch. 158-2'; effective date to month only; penalties not stated.
